main_text.head: REFUTATIO OBJECTI-ONUM PONTIFICIARUM AD asserendam concilii Tridentini & similium auctoritatem.
main_text.p: COacervant pontificii magnum numerum argumentorum, quibus causam & sedem suam confirmare conantur: & primum repetunt eadem fere, quae attigimus in Medulla Papismi, loco de conciliis.

Deinde, quia, pro more suo, numero certant, plura objiciunt.Pro-verb. 6. Dominum abominari eos, qui discordiam serant inter fratres: tales autem esse, quotquot contradicunt concilii Tridentini decretis, ¶[?]. Imò verò tales sunt; quotquot concilii Tridentini & similium edictis subscribunt, quia nulla legitimi concilii forma illic cernitur, sicuti evidentissimis argumentis comprobavimus. page.notes: The heading's "OBJECTI-ONUM" is hyphenated across the line end in print. The drop capital "C" is joined to "Oacervant" as "COacervant". The marginal reference at the right of the paragraph ("Proverb. 6.") is set in the text line, so it is kept as a note; its exact position may differ.
